high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white photograph of a person standing in what appears to be a clothing store or a personal wardrobe. The individual is wearing a strapless white top and a denim jacket that is unbuttoned, revealing the top underneath. The person has long, dark hair that falls over their shoulders. In the background, there are multiple racks of clothes. On the left side, there are several garments hanging on hangers, including what looks like a fur coat and some patterned items. On the right side, there are more clothes, including a leopard-print garment.
